name: Democratic Union of Kachakonia
description:
The second oldest political party in Kachakonia no longer plays as significant role as it used to before the war, when three different prime ministers held office on its behalf. 
    Traditionally liberal, it emphasizes the role of the middle class and strives to simplify the tax system as much as possible. Thanks to its moderate stance in most of the matters it often finds itself in the ruling coalition, when no party has big enough majority to rule alone.
